notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
We have updated an issue who caused problems placing units. Now it doesn’t matter if there is a unit in front a square you want to place a unit on. 
Technically the Units are ignored by the cursor when selecting a square to place your unit  ːsteamhappyː

Some users reported that the Update isnt automatic. IF the game doesnt auto update, just Uninstall and Reinstall, it wont take even 10 minutes. ːsteammockingː


Booker
